Borda vote: 2 points for 1st, 1 for 2nd, 0 for 3rd.
B wins; C is last. Remove C and recount. Who wins?
The loser flips the winner (working title)
C came last. Can dropping C change who wins?
A vs B on each ballot
Hint: count, then remove C and watch the A-B gap.
The loser flips the winner (working title)
C came last. Can dropping C change who wins?
A vs B on each ballot
Nobody changed their mind about A vs B: 3 voters put A
above B, 2 put B above A, both times. With C wedged
between B and A, voters 4-5 gave B +2 each, A’s voters
gave A +1: B won 7-6. Without C every gap is 1: A 3-2.
